how: Members call for help building and defending a vulnerable sign.
Recruitment targets friendly audiences because publicity may also bring attackers.
Members describe a shortage of hands and the circular difficulty of needing a bigger group to defend a bigger sign.
Members propose alternative words and signs rather than executing one fixed original design.
A later local builder combines starting the LOLI logo with an explicit invitation to help.
A room can take up maintenance of a sign already begun and completed by an outside group.
The local starter-to-call path applies to later builds but cannot explain an original mark completed before the room's visible participation.
Members report work on the background and describe rebuilding through clearing tiles.
The original blueprint is circulated expressly to make maintenance easier.
A template can support maintenance of an inherited design without a visible preceding design settlement in its thread.
A proposal to build a small message receives an explicit report of work on its pink background.

statement: Distinguishing originating, advertising, and moving coordination
how: Invitations, outside help requests, and proposed chat coordination need separate treatment because advertising an effort does not establish that planning moved there.
A handoff receives a brief promise to keep the work going and thanks for advocacy.
A bare joining line can explicitly credit discovery of the logo, leaving the written call's independent recruiting effect unresolved.
Informal canvas handoffs do not establish formal command, while later SFW rules and moderator recruitment establish explicit order during transition.
Accounts accused of multiplying placements belong to opponents, leaving defensive use of scripts or spare accounts unobserved.
Defence calls and accusations about enemy alts do not demonstrate that the defending room adopted machine hands under strain.
Members put repair before expansion, rally defenders, and return when their timers allow.
Hardening proposals change artwork or lettering to make hostile alterations harder.
Members attribute damage to particular accounts and dispute whether neighbouring national users or habitual attackers are responsible.
An inherited completed sign and repeated rebuilding make building and defence recur rather than form one local first-build-to-upkeep passage.
Neighbours request pixel adjustments, state available space, and receive an explicit change of plan.
Members refuse retaliation and ask opponents to respect their sign.
Border talk can prevent prospective overlap during building rather than follow neighbours eroding an already maintained work.
Sparing the neighbour's work can be the act that settles the boundary rather than a later consequence of an already settled border.
An explicit request for mutual help receives an agreement to help against vandalism.
Two neighbouring groups agree to mutual defence, fitting the smallest coalition form without establishing a larger organization.
Defensive strain produces an explicit outside help request, but the record does not establish that requested help arrived.
Mutual defence is itself the proposed deal, leaving a separate border-agreement-to-delivered-help mechanism unresolved.
Protection seeking and mutual promises support coalition formation under attack but do not verify subsequent joint defensive placements.
A member withholds outreach for lack of a representative mandate before any agreement is made or disputed.
The supported local form is uncertainty about permission to approach another room, not an observed dispute over a treaty's authority.
The record shows pre-outreach hesitation and mutual-help promises but no evidenced border-agreement-to-authority-dispute chain.
Intended diplomacy is visible, but the cited concepts do not establish a completed envoy mission carrying a proposal between rooms.
Protection seeking and a neighbour's limited statement of free space do not establish host rule over a guest work.
Members explicitly propose leaving the original location because targeted interference is ruining it.
A proposal to start elsewhere is followed within the rebuilding discussion by instructions to clear tiles and resume building.
The explicit relocation explanation names targeted interference, so accompanying doubts cannot alone establish insufficient hands as the cause.

statement: Disputing whether a group's message should be visible
how: Requests to respect the sign elicit moral condemnation of its meaning, extending the dispute beyond territorial damage or a named political symbol.
The live dispute and rallying slogan do not establish the prior inter-room quarrel required by this candidate condition.
A fandom slogan and an external origin account do not establish a pre-canvas room body or colour faith.
The replacement proposal does not name a rival through a documented tie predating the canvas.
An event room's later survival question and SFW rules do not reveal how a prior host bounded canvas talk.
Calls inside the event room do not show a host reacting to their flood by creating or redirecting discussion into that room.
The coded account of the originating Discord project does not evidence an April Fools takeover or prank framing of this subreddit.
Defenders announce an intact final sign, credit tiles, and salute and thank those who maintained it.
Celebration must retain its speaker and target because an earlier success claim belongs to opponents rather than the defending room.
The final announcement records the sign's unblemished state at the canvas close.
Reporting a finished work and marking its success can occur in one utterance rather than separate causal stages.
The completion announcement already reports the final condition, leaving a distinct celebration-causes-recording mechanism unestablished.
A final-state report and credit do not establish a dispute over cleaning a shared copy or correcting the historical record.
Members propose a lasting Discord companion, a future event, moderators, and new content for the subreddit.
Continuing the community depends in participants' account on SFW content rules and building a moderation team.
A proposed future archive does not establish that an existing record caused the room's decision to continue.

statement: Bringing existing defenders and new helpers into the room through the mark
how: Discovery of the visible logo brings a new helper in and connects a person who had thought they were defending alone.
Replacing another sign is proposed, but that proposal alone does not verify a completed conversion.
Incoming brigading must retain its hostile actor rather than be attributed to the defending room whose thread records it.
Defence calls and an incoming brigade do not establish that the focal room's mobilized builders became attackers.
The local contest is with identifiable hostile participants without an evidenced single rival room behind their taunts.
Restraint can answer incoming attack rather than a focal room's own attack call, so the direction of the attack must be retained.
A conversion proposal and later diplomacy do not establish an attack call causing border talk through an invoked truce.
Incoming attacks can be carried into mockery and ironic thanks without a focal-room attack call or a named rival community.
